mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days due to systemic financial risks.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, the manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals an impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 12-month MA during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline from prior month.
